To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the P80 domain is released from the surface of M. homini s cells and that the release is mediated by a two step secretion mechanism, in which P80 is first released from the membrane as a membrane anchored protein and then cleaved to a soluble form.

(1) the membrane protein P80, which is anchored in the membrane via its uncleaved signal sequence, interacts with a cytoplasmatic nucleoside triphosphatase, the HinT protein, (2) the signal sequence of P80 is protected from signal peptidases, (3) a 74 kDA protein, which represents a processed form of the membrane protein, can be detected in the supernatant.
P80, the Hin-T interacting protein of M. Hominis, is secreted into the supernatent of logarithmic phase cultures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of the secretion of the membrane complex P60-P80 and the role of the HinT protein in M. hominis.
the secretion of the P60/P80 complex of M. hominisothers and the role of the cytoplasmic HinT protein in this process.
the identification of a novel protein secreted by M. hominis, which is a secreted protein antigen.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the N-terminal signal peptide is essential for membrane anchoring, but not for secretion.
the P80 protein, a secreted antigen and virulence determinant, is the product of the P60/P80/HinT operon.
P80 is a secreted protein of M. h ominis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
P80, the Hin T interacting membrane protein, represents a secreted antigen in M. hominis.
P80 is a secreted, surface-exposed antigen of M. hominin.
the P80 signal peptide has an important role in the secretion process, and that this is a novel secretion pathway for a mycoplasma membrane protein.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the N- and C- terminus of the membrane protein are both required for secretion.
the P80 protein can be used for serodiagnosis of M. hominisinfections.
the P80 protein can be used as a secreted antigen for the diagnosis of M. hominisinfection.
